visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-angle close-up shot shows a boiling split-pot hot pot filled with white and brown broths. Surrounding the pot are numerous plates containing raw leafy greens, cabbage, carrots, tofu, and meatballs arranged on a dark table surface. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a man in a blue cap and a woman in a white shirt sitting against a beige textured wall. He points an orange toy gun at the camera while she holds a small ukulele, both speaking enthusiastically with wide facial expressions. (3) The female character, now wearing a pink cap and a light beige hoodie, is seen walking through the glass entrance of the 'God Guo' restaurant. Inside, a man in a blue cap presents a three-tier food rack holding fresh shrimp, clams, and red meat slices with visible marbled fat. (4) Successive close-up shots depict various food preparations: creamy white broth being poured from a ladle, a thin slice of beef being dipped into a soy-based sauce with fresh scallions, and the female eating noodles enthusiastically. The lighting is bright and warm indoors. (5) Promotional items including pink blessing cards and three sets of chopsticks in colorful green, red, and blue packaging are shown in handheld close-ups. A man is then seen throwing two red crescent-shaped blocks into a small wooden box on a table. (6) The video concludes with the couple sitting in front of a large branded 'God Guo' graphic wall. They are eating and laughing together, with the male character taking a large, satisfied bite of a meat-filled bowl and looking directly into the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a loud, punchy impact sound effect synchronized with the first visual cut of the boiling hot pot. The background music is high-energy electronic pop with a prominent bass beat. A male narrator begins speaking immediately in an excited tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect occurs as the scene transitions to the couple sitting against the wall. The male speaker's voice is clear and projected, maintaining a humorous tone while detailing the collaboration. No significant background noise is present. (3) A 'ding' sound effect plays as the female character enters the restaurant. The BGM tempo remains steady and driving. The male voice continues the narration, describing the hot pot ingredients with high pitch and vocal arousal. (4) Subtle bubbling sounds of broth and the metallic clink of spoons against ceramic are audible under the speech. The narrator's speech rate remains fast, with few structural pauses, emphasizing the abundance and quality of the meal presented. (5) A rustling sound of paper or plastic is audible as promotional cards and chopsticks are shown. The BGM continues its upbeat, synthetic rhythm. The female speaker provides short, high-pitched exclamations of delight between the male narrator's sentences. (6) A clear, percussive 'clack' sound is heard as wooden blocks hit a wooden tray, marking the start of the game segment. The male narrator's voice becomes even more assertive and commanding as he explains the prize rules. (7) The BGM swells for the final call to action. Both character voices overlap in a joyful, high-valence style to conclude the advertisement, followed by a final drum beat ending. Each vocal phrase is tightly edited.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Store Entrance -> Product Presentation -> Tasting Session -> Promotional Game -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional advertisement for the 'God Guo' hot pot restaurant's collaboration with the Dajia Jenn Lann Temple. It uses influencer personalities, appetizing close-up food shots, and traditional cultural elements (like Mazu and Bwa Bwei) to appeal to young consumers looking for both a trendy dining experience and good fortune.
